definitions.explanation: A nurse who is licensed by a prefectural governor and works under the direction of a doctor or a fully registered nurse, rather than holding the national nursing qualification.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{准看護師|じゅんかんごし}として{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: She works as a licensed practical nurse.

examples.japanese: {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}ってから{病院|びょういん}に{就職|しゅうしょく}した。
examples.english: After getting her practical nurse license, she got a job at a hospital.

examples.japanese: {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}から{看護師|かんごし}になるには、さらに{学校|がっこう}に{通|かよ}う{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: To become a registered nurse from a licensed practical nurse, you need to attend school further.

notes:
The prefix {准|じゅん} means "associate" or "semi-," marking a qualification one rank below the full {看護師|かんごし} (registered nurse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}の{資格|しかく}: a practical nurse license
- {准看護師|じゅんかんごし}として{働|はたら}く: to work as a practical nurse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {看護師|かんごし}: registered nurse — holds the national qualification and may direct practical nurses
- {看護助手|かんごじょしゅ}: nursing assistant — supports nursing work but holds no nursing license
